title: Requiem in C minor: Introitus et Kyrie
insight: Beethoven considered Cherubini the greatest living composer of his time, and this Requiem was performed at Beethoven's funeral in 1827.

title: Médée (Medea): Overture
insight: Brahms admired the overture to Medea immensely, keeping it as a permanent reference score in his study.

title: Symphony in D major: I. Largo - Allegro molto
insight: Cherubini's only symphony was commissioned directly by the Royal Philharmonic Society in London in 1815.

title: Marche funèbre
insight: Composed in 1820 following the assassination of the Duke of Berry, noted for its unusually stark instrumentation.

title: String Quartet No. 1 in E-flat major
insight: Cherubini began writing string quartets only after turning fifty, directly modeling them on Haydn's late works.

title: Ave Maria
insight: An intimate sacred piece written for soprano and English horn during his service at the Royal Chapel in Paris.
